The day that comes after Monday is Tuesday.

Here is the Ruby function `titleize_sentence` as requested:

```ruby
def titleize_sentence(sentence)
  # Define words that should remain lowercase
  lowercase_words = %w[and the or in with of]

  # Split the sentence into words, titleize each word, then join them back
  sentence.split.map do |word|
    # Check if the word (in lowercase) is in the list of words to keep lowercase
    if lowercase_words.include?(word.downcase)
      word.downcase
    else
      # Capitalize the first letter and downcase the rest
      word.capitalize
    end
  end.join(' ')
end
```
